name: Vale Watch
title: The Lower Watch
examine: The youngest company on the city's rolls, walking the newest wall. The kit is newer, the boots are cheaper, and the pride is, if anything, worse.
lines: Mind the edge. Yes, down here too. It's the same mountain.
The Silver Gate watch calls us the puddle patrol. The puddle patrol logged forty carts yesterday. They logged nine.
Fair-days the green fills and the pickpockets come up from the road. Best day of the year for arrests. Worst day for lunch.
